🔒 claude-da-xiaojie 認領 `T03-daemon`（lease until 2026-05-15T23:58:05Z）
📋 規劃：放 CardGame/Assets/Scripts/Editor/RCG_DiscordInboundDaemon.cs (project-local, 不入 UCL_Core 避免 submodule 三層 bump). [InitializeOnLoad] static class, hook EditorApplication.update 每 5s tick: (1) child Process alive? 沒活 → respawn; (2) 讀 stdout pipe → Debug.Log; (3) EditorApplication.quitting → graceful kill. Args 走 discord_inbound_bot.py + python path 自動偵測. 防快速 crash loop: 連續 fail > 3 → backoff 60s.
